The Dash & Dandy way

Good grooming is about more than a smart haircut.

It is about helping your dog feel comfortable, understood and proudly themselves. We pair professional technique with a gentle, unrushed approach — for a finish that looks dashing and feels good too.

Before their visit

A few useful things to know.

How do I ask about an appointment?+

Send Dash & Dandy a message on Instagram with your dog’s name, breed, the care you are looking for and any useful notes about their coat or temperament.

How much will my dog’s groom cost?+

Pricing can depend on breed, size, coat condition and the service needed. Message the salon directly for a current, accurate quote.

Do you offer teeth cleaning?+

Yes. Dash & Dandy offers Emmi-pet ultrasonic teeth cleaning. Ask the salon whether it is suitable for your dog.
